data.explanation: This letter confirms that your fiber internet order has been accepted and your line will go live on 3 December 2026, starting a 12-month minimum contract term at €39.90 per month. After the minimum term the contract continues monthly unless cancelled with one month's notice; the app will show you the relevant cancellation window when it becomes due. No action is needed now beyond keeping this confirmation for your records and ensuring the monthly fee can be collected.
